dimensions.assessment: Applies primarily to federal administrative agencies (NTIA, Department of the Interior, Forest Service) and congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Assistant Secretary shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report

dimensions.assessment: Creates an administrative reporting requirement without altering the underlying eligibility or rights for infrastructure deployment.
dimensions.evidence: describe-- (A) whether the Secretaries concerned have established... an online portal

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or fiscal costs are mentioned in the source text.
Narrowly focuses on reporting instructions for specific federal agencies concerning online application portals.
dimensions.evidence: require the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Communications and Information to report to Congress on any barriers

dimensions.assessment: Temporary reporting requirement that ends once the online portals are successfully established and notified.
dimensions.evidence: every 60 days thereafter until the Secretaries concerned each notify the Assistant Secretary

missing_information: Any cost estimates or resource allocations for building the online portals or producing the reports.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates periodic reports from the NTIA to Congress regarding the status of online application portals for communications use authorizations on public and forest lands.
